# SPECTRA design program: NMOS cascode CS + PMOS current-source load
# Changes vs. previous iteration:
#  - Mirror devices (Mpb, Mnb) are explicit width-scaled copies of M2 and Mr
#    (same L, same gm/Id density), so mirror ratios equal kb and iref exactly.
#  - Output DC is set by saturated current balance, not by headroom guesses.

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (8, 6, 11),            # signal NMOS gm/Id
    "L1":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),       # signal NMOS length
    "I1":    (22e-6, 18e-6, 24e-6), # stage current
    "kb":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.3),      # mirror-branch current as fraction of I1
    "gmid2": (7, 5.5, 8),           # PMOS load gm/Id
    "L2":    (2.0, 1.5, 3.0),       # PMOS load length
    "gmidc": (12, 9, 14),           # cascode NMOS gm/Id
    "Lc":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # cascode NMOS length
    "Rdiv":  (0.8e6, 0.4e6, 1.5e6), # cascode-bias divider total resistance
    "vx_t":  (0.35, 0.30, 0.42),    # DC voltage of cascode source node
}

VDD = 1.8
GM_MIR = 10.0
L_MIR = 1.0
VOUT_T = 1.0    # target output DC level used for device sizing


def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    CL = spec["cl"]
    I1 = p["I1"]
    I_b = p["kb"] * I1
    vx_t = p["vx_t"]
    rdiv = p["Rdiv"]

    # ---- NMOS bias reference (Mr) and its scaled copy (Mnb) ----
    mr = lut.size("n", GM_MIR, L_MIR, iref, vds=0.6)
    mnb_w = mr.W * I_b / iref          # same L, same gm/Id density -> ratio = I_b/iref

    # ---- PMOS load M2 and scaled diode Mpb ----
    vsd_p = VDD - VOUT_T
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=vsd_p)
    mpb_w = m2.W * p["kb"]             # identical geometry scaled by kb -> I_b = kb*I1

    # ---- NMOS cascode: source at vx_t, gate at vx_t + Vgs3 ----
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], I1, vds=VOUT_T - vx_t, vsb=vx_t)
    vc = vx_t + m3.vgs
    vc = min(max(vc, 0.6), VDD - 0.3)
    rb2 = rdiv * vc / VDD
    rb1 = rdiv - rb2

    # ---- signal device ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=vx_t)

    # ---- netlist ----
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "vout", "vc", "x", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", m2)
    n.M("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", mpb_w, p["L2"])
    n.M("Mnb", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", mnb_w, L_MIR)
    n.dev("Mr", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.R("Rb1", "vdd", "vc", rb1)
    n.R("Rb2", "vc", "vss", rb2)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    ro1 = 1.0 / m1.gds
    rcas = m3.intrinsic_gain * ro1
    ro2 = m2.intrinsic_gain / m2.gm
    rout = 1.0 / (1.0 / ro2 + 1.0 / rcas)

    gain_lin = gm1 * rout
    gain_db = db(gain_lin)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * CL)
    f3db = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rout * CL)

    # total supply current: iref + I1 + I_b + divider
    power = VDD * (iref + I1 + I_b + VDD / rdiv)

    # output window: bottom = cascode saturation edge, top = PMOS load saturation edge
    vlow = vx_t + m3.vdsat
    vhigh = VDD - m2.vdsat
    vout_dc = 0.5 * (vlow + vhigh)
    swing = 2.0 * min(vout_dc - vlow, vhigh - vout_dc)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": gain_db,
        "f3db": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout_dc,
        "swing": swing,
    }
